  <docTitle>
    <text>被讨厌的勇气：“自我启发之父”阿德勒的哲学课</text>
  </docTitle>
  <navMap>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_1" playOrder="1">
      <navLabel>
        <text>原书信息</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0000.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_2" playOrder="2">
      <navLabel>
        <text>相关内容</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0001.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_3" playOrder="3">
      <navLabel>
        <text>本书的赞誉</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0002.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_4" playOrder="4">
      <navLabel>
        <text>推荐序一 勇气的心理学</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0003.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_5" playOrder="5">
      <navLabel>
        <text>推荐序二 自我的枷锁和解放</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0004.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_6" playOrder="6">
      <navLabel>
        <text>推荐序三 人唯有在能够感觉自己有价值时，才有勇气</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0005.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_7" playOrder="7">
      <navLabel>
        <text>译者序</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0006.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_8" playOrder="8">
      <navLabel>
        <text>引言</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0007.html"/>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_9" playOrder="9">
      <navLabel>
        <text>第一夜 我们的不幸是谁的错？</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0009.html"/>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_10" playOrder="10">
        <navLabel>
          <text>不为人知的心理学“第三巨头”</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_000.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_11" playOrder="11">
        <navLabel>
          <text>再怎么“找原因”，也没法改变一个人</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_001.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_12" playOrder="12">
        <navLabel>
          <text>心理创伤并不存在</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_002.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_13" playOrder="13">
        <navLabel>
          <text>愤怒都是捏造出来的</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_003.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_14" playOrder="14">
        <navLabel>
          <text>弗洛伊德说错了</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_004.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_15" playOrder="15">
        <navLabel>
          <text>苏格拉底和阿德勒</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_005.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_16" playOrder="16">
        <navLabel>
          <text>你想“变成别人”吗？</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_006.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_17" playOrder="17">
        <navLabel>
          <text>你的不幸，皆是自己“选择”的</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_007.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_18" playOrder="18">
        <navLabel>
          <text>人们常常下定决心“不改变”</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_008.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_19" playOrder="19">
        <navLabel>
          <text>你的人生取决于“当下”</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0012_split_009.html"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_20" playOrder="20">
      <navLabel>
        <text>第二夜 一切烦恼都来自人际关系</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0013.html"/>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_21" playOrder="21">
        <navLabel>
          <text>为什么讨厌自己？</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_000.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_22" playOrder="22">
        <navLabel>
          <text>一切烦恼都是人际关系的烦恼</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_001.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_23" playOrder="23">
        <navLabel>
          <text>自卑感来自主观的臆造</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_002.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_24" playOrder="24">
        <navLabel>
          <text>自卑情结只是一种借口</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_003.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_25" playOrder="25">
        <navLabel>
          <text>越自负的人越自卑</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_004.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_26" playOrder="26">
        <navLabel>
          <text>人生不是与他人的比赛</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_005.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_27" playOrder="27">
        <navLabel>
          <text>在意你长相的，只有你自己</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_006.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_28" playOrder="28">
        <navLabel>
          <text>人际关系中的“权力斗争”与复仇</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_007.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_29" playOrder="29">
        <navLabel>
          <text>承认错误，不代表你失败了</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_008.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_30" playOrder="30">
        <navLabel>
          <text>人生的三大课题：交友课题、工作课题以及爱的课题</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_009.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_31" playOrder="31">
        <navLabel>
          <text>浪漫的红线和坚固的锁链</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_010.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_32" playOrder="32">
        <navLabel>
          <text>“人生谎言”教我们学会逃避</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_011.html"/>
      </navPoint>
      <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_33" playOrder="33">
        <navLabel>
          <text>阿德勒心理学是“勇气的心理学”</text>
        </navLabel>
        <content src="text/part0016_split_012.html"/>
      </navPoint>
    </navPoint>
    <navPoint class="chapter" id="num_34" playOrder="34">
      <navLabel>
        <text>第三夜 让干涉你生活的人见鬼去</text>
      </navLabel>
      <content src="text/part0017.html"/>
